title: Proportionate deduction cannot touch medicines, consumables, implants or tests
text: If you took a higher room category, a proportionate deduction may only apply to the 'associate medical expenses' defined in your policy. IRDAI does not allow these in that definition: cost of pharmacy and consumables; cost of implants and medical devices; cost of diagnostics. Insurers may not recover proportionate deductions on anything else.
source_title: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/151/06/2020 dated 11 June 2020, clauses 4 and 5

title: No proportionate deduction on ICU charges
text: Insurers are not permitted to apply proportionate deduction for ICU charges, as different categories of ICU are not there.
source_title: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/151/06/2020 dated 11 June 2020, clause 7

title: No proportionate deduction if the hospital doesn't bill by room category
text: Proportionate deductions cannot be applied for hospitals that do not follow differential billing, or for expenses where differential billing based on room category is not adopted.
source_title: IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/151/06/2020 dated 11 June 2020, clause 6

title: Consumables are covered by your policy
text: Your policy includes a consumables / non-medical items benefit, so consumables cannot be cut as 'non-payable'.

title: Hospital discount must reach the policyholder
text: IRDAI penalised an insurer after finding that discounts offered by network hospitals were not reflected in a way that passed the benefit to policyholders, and that detailed settlement letters explaining deductions were not issued.
source_title: IRDAI order IRDAI/E&C/ORD/MISC/138/12/2025 dated 15 Dec 2025 against Care Health Insurance (as reported)

title: Every deduction needs a written reason
text: A deduction with no clear reason should be explained in writing by the insurer. IRDAI has penalised an insurer for not issuing detailed settlement letters explaining deductions.
source_title: IRDAI order dated 15 Dec 2025 against Care Health Insurance (as reported)

title: The numbers must add up
text: Amount claimed minus all deductions and co-pay must equal the amount approved.

title: Only limits written in your policy can be applied
text: A co-pay or sub-limit can only be applied if your policy wording contains it, and only at the rate/amount it states.

title: Excess room rent must be calculated correctly
text: If the room cost more than the policy's room rent limit, only the difference per day times the number of days can be cut as excess room rent.
